title: Degree formula for the local Frobenius
statement:
Use the global finite-field datum and coefficient conventions of
[def-trf-coefficient-conventions], so $A=A_{E,n}$, $X_0$ is separated
of finite type over $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$.
Let $(K,\varphi)\in D^b_{ctf,\mathrm W}(X,A)$ be a strict Weil complex
[def-trf-strict-weil-complex]. Let $x\in|X_0|$ be a closed point of
positive degree $d_x=[\kappa(x):\mathbf F_q]$, let $m\geq1$ be an integer
divisible by $d_x$, and let $x_m\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^{d_x}})$ be a
point above $x$. Write $\bar x$ for its geometric lift to $X$ and put
$F_x=F_{x_m,d_x}$, the one-circuit local Frobenius of
[def-trf-frobenius-operators], well defined up to conjugation by
[lem-trf-local-frobenius-conjugacy]. Then for every
$y\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$ above $x$, with geometric lift $\bar y$,
$$
\operatorname{tr}_A\bigl(F_{y,m}\mid K_{\bar y}\bigr)
=
\operatorname{tr}_A\bigl(F_x^{\,m/d_x}\mid K_{\bar x}\bigr)
$$
in $A$, where $\operatorname{tr}_A$ is the categorical trace of
[def-trf-categorical-trace].

proof.text:
*Step 1: iteration at the chosen lift.* Put $d=d_x$, write $m=rd$ with $r\geq1$, and denote by $z_n$ the rational point at level $n$ with geometric lift $\bar x$ whenever $d\mid n$. Clause (1) of [lem-trf-local-frobenius-conjugacy] says that $\bar x$ is fixed by $\Phi^n$ for all such positive $n$. Write $P_n=Lg_\gamma^{n*}$ and use $K$ also for its underlying complex; every stalk below means the point fiber of the derived pullback, as in [def-trf-frobenius-operators]. Use the canonical composition comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], specialized to constant coefficients $A$ and the maps $\bar x$, $\Phi^n$, and $g_\gamma^n$. Its coefficient-identification hypotheses hold for constant $A$. For any complex $L$, let
$$
t_{n,L}:L_{\bar x}\xrightarrow{\sim}(P_nL)_{\bar x}
$$
be the inverse pullback-stalk identification at $\Phi^n\bar x=\bar x$, followed by $\kappa^{(n)}_{L,\bar x}$ of [prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison]. Thus $t_{n,K}=\tau_{z_n,n}$ in [def-trf-frobenius-operators]. For positive multiples $a,b$ of $d$, the multiplicativity of $\kappa^{(n)}$ and composition of pullback-stalk identifications give, under $P_{a+b}\cong P_aP_b$,
$$
t_{a+b,K}=t_{a,P_bK}\circ t_{b,K}.
$$
Indeed, the two arrows on the right identify the stalk first along $\Phi^b$ and then along $\Phi^a$; their composite identifies it along $\Phi^{a+b}$, and the comparison factors combine to $\kappa^{(a+b)}$. The canonical comparisons agree under reassociation: on the termwise pullback model specified by the composition node, both send a section to the same iterated inverse image, so applying the point fiber gives the same stalk arrow. Thus no extra choice of a stalk identification is involved. Naturality in $L$, applied to $\varphi^{[b]}:P_bK\to K$ from [def-trf-iterated-weil-map], gives the typed equality
$$
(P_a\varphi^{[b]})_{\bar x}\circ t_{a,P_bK}
=t_{a,K}\circ\varphi^{[b]}_{\bar x}.
$$
The cocycle identity [lem-trf-iterated-weil-cocycle] now yields
$$
\begin{aligned}
F_{z_{a+b},a+b}
&=\varphi^{[a]}_{\bar x}\circ(P_a\varphi^{[b]})_{\bar x}
  \circ t_{a,P_bK}\circ t_{b,K}\\
&=\varphi^{[a]}_{\bar x}\circ t_{a,K}\circ
  \varphi^{[b]}_{\bar x}\circ t_{b,K}
=F_{z_a,a}\circ F_{z_b,b}.
\end{aligned}
$$
For $r=1$, $z_d=x_m$ and $F_{z_d,d}=F_x$. For $r\geq2$, take $a=d$ and $b=(r-1)d>0$ in this equality. Induction gives $F_{z_m,m}=F_x^r$ on $K_{\bar x}$; no level-zero operator or cocycle is used.

*Step 2: changing the lift and taking traces.* Given $y\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$ above $x$, clause (1) of [lem-trf-local-frobenius-conjugacy] gives $0\leq i<d$ with $\bar y=g_\gamma^i\bar x$. Its clauses (2) and (3) supply an isomorphism $T_i:K_{\bar y}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_{\bar x}$ and
$$
F_{y,m}=T_i^{-1}\circ F_{z_m,m}\circ T_i
=T_i^{-1}\circ F_x^r\circ T_i.
$$
For $i=0$ take $T_0=1$; no undefined $\varphi^{[0]}$ is needed. Multiplying the displayed equality on the left by $T_i$ gives $T_i\circ F_{y,m}=F_x^r\circ T_i$. The stalk assertion of [prop-trf-compact-support-perfectness] puts both $K_{\bar y}$ and $K_{\bar x}$ in the perfect-complex category $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$: its hypothesis holds because the coefficient conventions give a separated finite-type structure map and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. Apply clause (1) of [prop-trf-trace-formal-laws] with $P_1=K_{\bar y}$, $P_2=K_{\bar x}$, $w=T_i$, $v_1=F_{y,m}$ and $v_2=F_x^r$. This gives the asserted trace equality, since $r=m/d_x$.

split_report.summary: Rechecked the earlier attempt against both current blueprint paragraphs, Stacks Tag 0D6D, and every cited statement. The proof uses typed stalk transports, explicit naturality and positive-exponent induction, then typed conjugacy and categorical trace invariance with stalk perfectness. The existing canonical derived-pullback composition theorem is cited directly. All nine quotations were verified against the shared DAG, and four additional authentic Mathlib searches were recorded. No new nodes.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes both proof paragraphs of the current main-20261015 blueprint node lem-trf-frobenius-degree-formula.

tool_uses.why: The blueprint proof explicitly uses its natural multiplicative comparison to compose canonical stalk transports; the proper-global unit has no replacement for this comparison.
The blueprint proof explicitly uses the cocycle of iterated Weil maps to factor the operator; the proper-global unit has no separate cocycle theorem.
Only its geometric-stalk perfectness clause is used to check the domain of categorical trace; no statement of the proper-global unit supplies it.
The blueprint proof explicitly uses categorical-trace conjugacy invariance after changing the lift; the proper-global unit has no separate trace-invariance theorem.

Canonical composition of derived pro-etale pullbacks supplies the fixed-point stalk identification used in the blueprint iteration argument. It is a general functoriality tool with constant coefficients, not a replacement of the unit route.

Statement: it now states the setting (coefficients, strict Weil complex, lifts, categorical trace) explicitly and adds m>=1. Both sides of the formula are undefined for m<=0, so this is not a weakening, and the three citers keep everything they use. Step 1: t_{n,K} is exactly tau_{z_n,n} from def-trf-frobenius-operators. The identity t_{a+b}=t_{a,P_bK}∘t_{b,K} follows from the naturality of rho, the multiplicative kappa^{(m)} and the reassociation in the composition lemma. The naturality square and the cocycle for a,b>=1 give F_{z_{a+b}}=F_{z_a}F_{z_b}, and induction (base z_d=x_m) gives F_x^r with no exponent-zero operator. Step 2: conjugacy clauses (1)-(3) with z_0=x̄ give F_{y,m}=T_i^{-1}F_x^rT_i in the correct orientation, with T_0=1. The compact-support perfectness stalk clause puts both stalks in Perf(A); the main-20261015 blueprint confirms its D^b_fin means the categorical-trace category. Trace-formal-laws clause (1) then gives the equality. This also repairs the blueprint's untyped T_i^{-1}F_{z,d}T_i=F_{x_m,d_x}. Edge cases checked: K=0, X_0 empty, Spec F_q, m=d, d=2 with m=4. No cycle, no new nodes, no duplicate in the DAG. Accepted tool_uses: scheme-galois-comparison, iterated-weil-cocycle, trace-formal-laws, compact-support-perfectness (stalk clause only), and pbc derived-pullback-composition (generic, constant coefficients). No SGA source is used.
